notes: Judgement call on I1. The paper is mainly a low-temperature TDS (TPD) study, and TDS alone would not meet I1. It also plots 77 K H2 adsorption isotherms (up to about 50 bar) for activated carbon (Fig. 4 inset) and purified SWCNTs (Fig. 5 inset), described as 'measured' and giving 2.7 and 2.4 wt%. No reference is attached to them, so they are not shown to be quoted from other work, and the sentence compares them with the TDS values of the same two samples. The paper does not name the instrument or say whether they are gravimetric or volumetric, and its Experimental section describes only TDS. I1 is coded met on that basis. If the isotherms were judged not to be the paper's own, the code would be no_conditions_stated. I2: activated carbon (BET 1065 m2/g) and HiPco SWCNT (854 m2/g) both carbon. I3: 77 K stated; pressure from the inset axis (isotherm points to about 45 bar). I4: BET 1065 m2/g (activated carbon, N2 at 77 K); 854 m2/g for SWCNT stated on the same page. Not retracted (record is_retracted false; no retraction notice in the text). Not a review. No statement that the uptake values were published before.
